hero.heading: Simple prices. Every feature.
hero.subhead_founding: $299 a year per school program when you subscribe by June 30, 2027, or $19 a month for a private studio that subscribes by December 31, 2026. Your price stays the same every time you renew.
hero.subhead_school_founding: $299 a year per school program when you subscribe by June 30, 2027, or $24 a month for a private studio. Every feature included.
hero.subhead_standard: $349 a year per school program, or $24 a month for a private studio, with every feature included.

plan.name: Program Partner
plan.note_founding: Subscribe by June 30, 2027 and keep this price every year you renew. Programs that join on or after July 1, 2027 pay $349 a year.
plan.note_standard: Billed once a year. Cancel any time, and you keep access through the year you paid for.

studio.name: Program Partner for private studios
studio.note_founding: Every feature for one private studio, billed monthly or yearly. Subscribe by December 31, 2026 and keep this price every time you renew. Studios that join on or after January 1, 2027 pay $24 a month or $240 a year.
studio.note_standard: Every feature for one private studio. Billed monthly or yearly; cancel any time, and you keep access through the month or year you paid for.

included.heading: What's included
items: Every feature on this site, turned on or off to fit your program.
Parent and student portals at no cost to families.
Guided setup, and support from someone who has run a program.
No payment fees. Families pay through your own processor account, and Program Partner never takes a percentage.
Woodshed All-Access, Woodshed's subscription for directors, at no extra cost, including the Activity Template Library.

setup.heading: Setup and import
setup.body: Guided setup is included. If you want us to move your records in, send us your spreadsheets and we'll import your students, families, inventory and music library. Importing is quoted to your data, because a clean 50-row roster and a 15-year-old instrument spreadsheet are different jobs.

purchasing.heading: Buying through your school
purchasing.body: Need a quote for your bookkeeper, an invoice for a purchase order, a W-9 or a vendor form? Ask and we'll send it. Your program can start as soon as the invoice is sent.

items.a: Subscribe by June 30, 2027 and you pay $299 a year for as long as your subscription renews without a break.
items.a_studio_founding: A private studio that subscribes by December 31, 2026 pays $19 a month or $190 a year on the same terms.

items.q: Is it per director or per program?
items.a: Per program. Your staff, booster officers, families and students all sign in at no extra cost.

items.q: Is there a plan for private studios?
items.a: Yes. A private studio has its own plan, billed monthly or yearly, with every feature included. The price is in the studio card above.

items.q: Can our school pay by purchase order or check?
items.a: Yes. We'll send a quote, then an invoice due in 30 days, and a W-9. Your program can start as soon as the invoice is sent.
We'll email you within one business day to schedule your guided setup.
Any time. You keep access through the year (or, for a studio on monthly billing, the month) you paid for, and you can export your records.

items.q: Do families pay anything to use it?
items.a: No. Families only pay the fees your program assigns.

Yes. Woodshed is free for students, and Woodshed All-Access, its subscription for directors, comes with every Program Partner plan. There's nothing extra to buy. It includes the Activity Template Library: save any Woodshed activity as a reusable preset, browse a library of templates other directors shared and we reviewed, and submit your own for review. Your directors sign in to Woodshed with their Program Partner accounts.

closing.heading: Ready when you are.
closing.body: Subscribe today, or schedule a demo and see it with your program in mind first.
